ratings_why.fun: Every tier does its job and the Burrow gives a real spend-or-keep call each turn, with count and size multiplying into a late game I'd happily draft toward.
ratings_why.distinct: Kit size echoes Battlegrounds' growing tokens, but an off-board reserve that is fight HP, currency and missiles at once plays unlike any of today's tribes.

verdict_why: Nothing is broken or unreadable; the hot spots are numbers for the owner to balance, so more passes would make it different, not better.

points.text: Tiers 3 and 4 have no Kit-size card before Herding Council, so 1/1 Kits feel thin against midgame boards. A small Kit-size piece at Tier 3 would smooth the curve.

With Herald, Litter Keeper and Matron refilling about 13 Kits a turn, the Burrow settles near 26 and Ferrywife pays about +13/+13 to every real unit each turn. That is the tribe's hottest number; leave it hot and let the owner tune it.
Council raises Kit size every turn with no cap while Kit count also grows, so the Herd's total stats grow quadratically. Worth a sim with golden Council plus golden Herald.
Say whether a second Litter Keeper (easy with Identical Cousin) triggers on the first one's extra Kits. Both are capped, so it's a wording gap, not a loop.
Gerd's Bristle on a long Onward chain can stall low-Attack boards into ties. A tie-break or a fight-length cue would keep the Tide from feeling like a wall.

standouts.why: A Banner that grows as each front Kit dies is a clear, exciting payoff that turns the chain into one giant.
Draining half the Burrow into permanent stats creates the tribe's best tension with the Onward Tide.
Names the comp at Tier 3 and makes the Burrow matter in fights right away.

weakest.why: A one-shot cash-in at Tier 3, when the Burrow is still small; it rarely beats keeping the Kits.
Three 1/1 Kits falling deal little until Gerd or Snow Hall Guard arrives.
A single Kit-size bump; useful but plain.

flags.note: Steady Burrow refill makes Ferrywife a large permanent gain every turn, doubled when golden or copied by Cousin.
Uncapped Kit size growth times rising Kit count is quadratic over a long game.
Cantor scales with both Kit count and Kit size inside a fight; golden Cantor with golden Mother Lemen needs a sim.
Bristle Kits plus Onward can drag fights into ties against low-Attack boards.
Unclear whether two Litter Keepers trigger on each other's extra Kits; capped either way.
